Title: The Earth Is the Lord’s
Author: Pastor Jane Doe
Memory verse text: The earth is the Lord’s, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
Message:
Who owns your life? It sounds like an easy question, but look at how you actually live and you might answer differently.

A steward is someone put in charge of a house that isn’t theirs. They live in it and make decisions every day, but they are still not the owner.
Prayer: Lord, everything I have comes from Your hand. Teach me to hold it loosely and use it for You. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
Reflection questions:
What do you treat as “yours” that really belongs to God?
What is one thing you can give back to Him this week?

Title: Faithful in Little
Author: Pastor Jane Doe
Memory verse text: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much.
Message:
God often grows us through small, unseen acts of faithfulness.

Today, look for one small thing to do well, as if for Him.
Prayer: Father, help me to be faithful in the little things You have given me today. Amen.
Reflection questions: Where is God asking you to be faithful in something small?
